svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: GlassDock architecture
svg.desc: Data flow diagram. Hyprland sends IPC events (socket2) to the Model, screen captures (wlr-screencopy) to a mipmapped backdrop texture, and pointer and layer-shell input to the layout and animation state. All three feed the GLES 3 renderer (glass shader, icons and labels, menu) which draws into one wlr-layer-shell surface per screen; surface commits return to Hyprland. A single process redraws only while animating.
svg.text: GlassDock architecture one frame, end to end

g.text: one EGL context shared by all screens

svg.text: surface commit, compositor presents the frame
Single process · one surface per monitor · redraws only while animating · Intel iGPU via Mesa (NVIDIA stays asleep)
